resources.string: Keeps Instagram to your chats, reels friends send, and your Saved.

Sidedoor watches Instagram, and only Instagram, so it can close the feed, the Reels tab and Explore before they draw you in. Chats, reels your friends send and your Saved stay open.\n\nIt stores nothing it sees off your phone. Sidedoor has no internet permission at all.
Sidedoor did not recognise Instagram %1$s\'s inbox. The guard may be misreading screens until its rules are updated.
